name: Bonanza Peak
blurb: The highest non-volcanic peak in Washington, reached by boat and bus to Holden Village before the climbing starts.
permit: Reach Holden on the Lady of the Lake ferry to Lucerne and the Holden Village bus. Free self-issued wilderness permit. Trails here closed after the 2025 Martin Fire: check with the Chelan Ranger District before planning.

routes.name: Mary Green Glacier
routes.summary: The Holden Lake trail, slabs and moraine to the Mary Green Glacier, then loose class 3–4 rock on the upper mountain to a horn-shaped summit at the south end of the ridge.
skills: Roped glacier travel and crevasse rescue
Route finding on loose class 3–4 rock

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Holden Lake
waypoints.note: Lakeside camps below the east face.

sections.note: West up Railroad Creek from Holden, then the Holden Lake trail north.
Slabs, moraine and snow west of the lake to the glacier.
Up the Mary Green Glacier to the rock of the upper mountain.
Loose class 3–4 to the summit horn. Most parties rappel on the descent.
